description: Meet John Angelo De Joya, the Philippines-based developer behind J0hnvexcoder. Explore his web development experience, engineering approach and Linux practice.
heading: The person behind the systems.
paragraphs: I’m John Angelo De Joya, also known as J0hnvexcoder. I build websites and software from Bulacan, Philippines, with a practical interest in what happens beyond the interface.

My work spans responsive frontend development, custom applications, Python automation and hands-on Linux infrastructure. I connect those skills around the actual problem rather than selecting tools for their own sake.

Client delivery and independent projects inform each other. Contract web development taught me to work to a scope and timeline; my self-hosted environment gives me space to investigate deployment, networking, storage and monitoring.

I’m available for remote freelance projects and technical roles. I can discuss collaboration with teams in the Philippines, the United States, Australia, the United Kingdom, Singapore and other markets. I’m based in the Philippines; these are collaboration locations, not offices.
